title: CHEd ok to issue rule recognizing lived names of transgender, queer Filipinos
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Higher Education (CHEd) is open to issuing a policy on recognizing the lived names of transgender and queer Filipinos across higher education institutions…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Higher Education (CHEd) is open to issuing a policy on recognizing the lived names of transgender and queer Filipinos across higher education institutions (HEIs). Makati Rep. Monique Lagdameo on Wednesday gave this information during the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of CHEd for next year. She was asked by Akbayan Party-list Percival Cendãna if the CHEd is considering a policy issuance on recognition of lived names of the members of the LGBTQIA+ community (lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual).
